{{Quote|But there are so few of us.|Unnamed birdlike Jedi trainee|<ref name="Darksaber (novel)">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
An''' avian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] '''student''' at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. He was present in the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]] when [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Dorsk 81]] returned to Yavin 4 from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to warn the students of an imminent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assault on Yavin 4|attack]] that began just minutes after their arrival. He did not believe that they could win the battle, due to the enemy's superior numbers.
